places-cingle-de-la-mola-remigia-abric-v.story: 165 km from Ares del Maestre to Ares del Maestre, about 2 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Calçaes del matá, Abric del mas dels Ous, Valmayor V and back through Abric del mas dels Ous. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.
